title: Stop agent loops that make no progress
narrative: Fangore’s repair loop keeps asking the same question and getting the same answer. A versioned ceiling must end as no-progress — never fake success — and nested repair must share parent budget. Graph repeating nodes additionally require an explicit stop contract at linkage (`fangore_graph_linkage_preflight`). See inspiration requirements for stop contracts[^insp-stop].
implementation:
`ConvergenceContract` / `ConvergenceGuard` fingerprint windows and nested budget slices. `StopContract` in `mechaharness.stop_contract` is the graph-facing alias for the same ceilings plus trigger/continuation/success/abort fields. Escalation may request more evidence, but ceilings never count as task success.

Covers: POL-03.
validation: Harness `graph_execution` op `convergence_ceiling` → `_run_convergence_ceiling`. Unit: `tests/test_convergence.py`. Linkage stop enforcement: `fangore_graph_linkage_preflight`.
